snippet.title: Why Vigorous Exercise Is 4–10x More Effective Than Moderate (New Evidence)
snippet.description:
One minute of vigorous exercise may be worth up to ten minutes of “moderate” cardio for extending lifespan and preventing chronic disease. In this Journal Club episode, Rhonda Patrick, PhD and endurance athlete Brady Holmer dissect a new Nature Communications study of more than 70,000 adults showing that vigorous intensity is roughly 4–10x more potent than moderate activity for reducing all-cause mortality, cardiovascular events, type 2 diabetes, and cancer outcomes—far beyond the long-standing 1:2 rule embedded in global exercise guidelines.

Download my free guide—"How to Train According to the Experts"—at https://howtotrainguide.com/

snippet.title: The Secret to Bringing People Together | Mel Robbins #shorts
snippet.description:
Order your copy of The Let Them Theory 👉 https://melrob.co/let-them-theory 👈 The #1 Best Selling Book of 2025 🔥 Discover how much power you truly have. It all begins with two simple words. Let Them.
—
If hosting feels like work instead of being fun, this will change that.

Priya Parker is a connection expert and bestselling author of The Art of Gathering. She is teaching you how to make the time you spend together feel the way it should: enjoyable.

Priya Parker explains that the mistake most people make is trying to do everything themselves.

The pressure to host, to entertain, to keep everyone engaged. That’s what turns gatherings into work.

Instead, give people a role.

Let them bring something. Share something. Contribute in their own way.

Because the moment people feel like it’s their gathering too, things get lighter.. People loosen up, laugh more and really connect.

On this episode of The Mel Robbins Podcast, Priya Parker shares simple ways to make time together feel more fun, more meaningful, and truly unforgettable.
